title: Bounded CLI reads and deliberate full detail
summary: Reads declare no side effects; event emission makes a function a write. The generated read catalog and dispatcher use the same classification. Routine replies use concise command-specific projections and pages. Write receipts print what changed; --json prints everything. Only oversized registered human reads refuse atomically above 28,000 UTF-8 bytes; the refusal names the field, filter, limit and paging flags that command really has and points to command help. Every registered read takes --section HEADING to print one Markdown section; an oversized reply with headings lists each heading's size and exact --section command, so a long document read never dead-ends. The generic human writer indents multiline scalar values under their labels, so captured log lines and embedded Markdown cannot become section headings; document readers render intentional Markdown sections explicitly.
